description: Six passionate coders, gamers, and editors combining technical skill with creativity to build space-ready solutions. 🚀
summary: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive learning website that helps young explorers discover space through play. Recruits create an astronaut identity and progress through three hands-on stations: a launch-preparation challenge, a space-facts quiz, and a planet-navigation activity. Each station gives feedback as players go and rewards their progress, turning space learning into a guided mission. We built the experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a browser-based learning game for young space explorers. Players create an astronaut identity and move through three stations: a launch-preparation challenge, a space-facts quiz, and a planet-navigation activity. Short tasks, visual cues, immediate feedback, and progress rewards make the experience interactive and easy to follow. The project aims to make introductory space learning engaging through play. We built it with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and designed it to run in a web browser without an installation.
